Install Google Apps

✍️ Made by Jon F

1

Navigate to the site you want to "Install"

2

Find the Install As App button in settings

Click the 3 Dots in the top right corner

Towards the bottom find "Case, Save, and Share"

Click "Install Page as App"

3

Name The App you are Installing

4

Keep the App in your Dock for future use

Click and hold on the new app icon

Hover the mouse over "Options"

Click "Keep in Dock"

💡

This process can be done for almost any site you frequently visit!

You can also open this window back in Chrome anytime.

Click the dots in the top right corner, then click "Open in Chrome"
